understanding: Cover WISHBONE pin address crossed with LCR DLAB gating for divisor versus normal aliasing at 0-1 plus normal 2-6 and illegal 7 sampled on ACK completion via wishbone_slave_interface monitor.
preconditions: DUT is responder on wishbone_slave_interface using physical ports wb_adr_i wb_dat_i wb_dat_o wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i wb_ack_o wb_sel_i with UART_ADDR_WIDTH 3 UART_DATA_WIDTH 8 DATA_BUS_WIDTH_8; pin addresses 0 1 are aliased by DLAB
Clock period fixed per test with reset applied via reset itself before traffic; wishbone_slave_interface agent owns its driven inputs and observes outputs; other interfaces idle-observed only
LCR at pin address 3 provides symbolic DLAB1_DIVISOR selecting divisor latches at 0-1 and DLAB0_NORMAL selecting normal registers at 0-1
Monitor reconstructs completed transactions on WB_ACK_O observed on clock edge; dedicated coverage subscriber taps monitor analysis port
Dependency t_dlab_gate_chk alias handling is architectural prerequisite; this feature adds only address by DLAB cross sampling
stimulus_steps: Bring-up via wishbone_slave_interface agent only: WAIT for reset done and bus idle then program LCR at pin address 3 to symbolic DLAB1_DIVISOR

FOR DLAB in [DLAB1_DIVISOR then DLAB0_NORMAL]: IF DLAB1 drive divisor alias accesses at pin addr 0 LSB RW and pin addr 1 MSB RW; IF DLAB0 drive normal accesses at pin addr 0 RBR read plus THR write and pin addr 1 IER RW using symbolic legal byte data
FOR each DLAB state drive pin addresses 2 3 4 5 6 with read and write where documented access permits to hit addr2_to_6 bins
Drive pin address 7 read and write attempt under each DLAB to observe illegal addr_7_any_dlab disposition without assuming ACK or data behavior

WAIT for WB_ACK_O completion per transfer within request_timeout_cycles operational limit; FOR random exploration vary order of addr-DLAB combinations with directed DLAB programming retained; TERMINATE on all bins driven or operational timeout
CLEANUP program LCR to DLAB0_NORMAL and leave wishbone bus idle-owned for handoff
coverage_steps: SAMPLE cg_cross_addr_dlab.cross_addr_X_dlab on each WB_ACK_O completion observed on clock edge via dedicated subscriber tapping wishbone_slave_interface monitor; drivers never supply coverage events

COMPARE observed pin value wb_adr_i in 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 plus 7 against current DLAB state from LCR bit7 to bins addr0_dlab0_RBR_THR addr0_dlab1_DLL_SB addr1_dlab0_IER addr1_dlab1_DLM_SB addr2_to_6_dlab0_normal addr2_to_6_dlab1 plus illegal addr_7_any_dlab
SAMPLE per-instance false single UART instance Tier 2 configuration cross; exclude configuration-write payload semantics from cross; no data COMPARE in coverage
WAIT for ACK completion for each driven address-DLAB combination; TERMINATE sampling on all supported bins hit or operational timeout
completion: DONE when cg_cross_addr_dlab cross_addr_X_dlab bins addr0_dlab0_RBR_THR plus addr0_dlab1_DLL_SB plus addr1_dlab0_IER plus addr1_dlab1_DLM_SB plus addr2_to_6_dlab0_normal plus addr2_to_6_dlab1 SAMPLED and illegal addr_7_any_dlab disposition recorded
BOUND by TEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES plus drain_cycles and request_timeout_cycles as TESTBENCH operational limits not DUT timing; TIMEOUT is testbench failure
CLEANUP leaves LCR DLAB 0 with wishbone bus idle-owned for traffic handoff; TERMINATE on coverage done or operational timeout

facts.statement: Normal registers at addresses 0-1 are inaccessible when DLAB is 1 defining divisor versus normal aliasing.
facts.quote: At this time the above registers at addresses 0-1 can’t be accessed.

facts.statement: Divisor latch registers are accessible when LCR bit7 DLAB is set to 1.
facts.quote: The registers can be accessed when the 7th (DLAB) bit of the Line Control Register is set

facts.statement: Divisor LSB at pin address 0 is 8-bit RW LSB of divisor.
facts.quote: Divisor Latch Byte 1 (LSB) 0 8 RW The LSB of the divisor

facts.statement: Divisor MSB at pin address 1 is 8-bit RW MSB of divisor.
facts.quote: Divisor Latch Byte 2 1 8 RW The MSB of the divisor

facts.statement: Receiver Buffer at pin address 0 is 8-bit R Receiver FIFO output.
facts.quote: Receiver Buffer 0 8 R Receiver FIFO output

facts.statement: Transmitter Holding Register at pin address 0 is 8-bit W Transmit FIFO input.
Interrupt Enable normal register at pin address 1 is RW.
Line Control Register at pin address 3 controls connection including DLAB gating.
facts.quote: Line Control Register 3 8 RW Control connection

questions: What is active polarity of wb_rst_i required reset duration clock sampling edge for ACK reconstruction and must monitor flush in-flight versus flag reset-during-transfer as error?

What are documented WISHBONE handshake semantics: stability of wb_adr_i wb_we_i wb_sel_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i during transfer wb_ack_o single versus multi-cycle window wb_dat_o validity on reads and back-to-back handling?

What are wb_sel_i legal values in DATA_BUS_WIDTH_8 build is address representation pin values 0-6 versus offsets and what is handling of illegal pin address 7 and mismatched DLAB access at 0-1 with ACK and read data alias versus blocked?

What is expected read data for address 0 FIFO alias during gating given side-effect behavior should addr0 be coverage-only without data COMPARE and what masks apply to IER reserved bits and LCR bits 6-0 when programming DLAB?
